name: What is the step-by-step process for installing kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What is the step-by-step process for installing kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabinet installation typically begins with inspecting and marking the walls to locate the highest point of the subfloor. Next, installers find and mark wall studs, establish level reference lines, and map out plumbing and electrical rough-ins. Upper cabinets are generally hung first so workers can access the wall without reaching over lower units. Once uppers are anchored into structural studs, base cabinets are set, leveled using shims, and fastened together. The final phase involves hanging doors, aligning drawer slides, and installing finish carpentry elements such as crown molding, toe kicks, and filler strips.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installers mark high floor points, locate studs, mount upper cabinets, level and anchor base units, and finish with doors and trim.
